sentences.zh: 我只是在为不同的理念传道而已。

sentences.en: I mean, I never met a fight that I was invited to that I didn't accept wholeheartedly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我从不拒绝任何找上门来的争论，我总是全心全意地接受。

sentences.en: I mean, I fought with everybody.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我和每个人都吵过架。

sentences.en: I fought with everybody on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 我在推特上和每个人都吵过。

sentences.en: I fought with everybody everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我在任何地方都和人吵。

sentences.en: I could not let anything lay.
sentences.zh: 我什么事都放不下。

sentences.en: I had on my boxing gloves, and I was ready to duke it out, and I did.
sentences.zh: 我戴上拳击手套，准备大干一场，而且我也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, to some degree, you can take your extreme ideology and just locate it in a different zip code.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，在某种程度上，你可以把你极端的意识形态换个地方继续坚持。

sentences.en: And I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: And again, David, this goes back to like my childhood, because we were taught in my church culture that, and this is not hyperbolic,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，大卫，这要追溯到我的童年，因为在我的教会文化中，我们被教导——这绝非夸大其词——

sentences.en: or we were taught that we were responsible for people's eternity.
sentences.zh: 或者说，我们被教导说我们要为他人的永生负责。

sentences.en: Like, it was on our hands.
sentences.zh: 就像是，这掌握在我们手中。

sentences.en: Like, if we did not evangelize, if we did not tell people about God in the right way, and if they went to hell, that's on us.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不传教，如果我们没有用正确的方式向人们传达上帝的旨意，而他们因此下了地狱，那责任就在我们。

sentences.en: Like, that is a heavy responsibility to put on the head of an eight-year-old.
sentences.zh: 这对于一个八岁的孩子来说，是多么沉重的责任啊。

sentences.en: That took a long time to purge.
sentences.zh: 这花了很长时间才摆脱掉。

sentences.en: A really long time to purge.
sentences.zh: 花了很长很长的时间才摆脱。

sentences.en: I am not responsible for everybody's worldview, for their choices, for their actions, for what they think.
sentences.zh: 我不必为每个人的世界观、他们的选择、他们的行为或他们的想法负责。

sentences.en: I thought for so long, I'm like, I'm a good communicator.
sentences.zh: 我曾长期认为，我是一个很好的沟通者。

sentences.en: I'm good at this.
sentences.zh: 我很擅长这个。

sentences.en: I will communicate so brilliantly that I'll just convince everybody to believe what I believe.
sentences.zh: 我会沟通得如此出色，以至于能说服每个人相信我所相信的。

sentences.en: You know, I'll get everybody to be right with me, because I'm so good at talking.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我会让每个人都和我达成一致，因为我太会说话了。

sentences.en: So, here I sit, right here in midlife, going, oh, not sure that was true.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在我人到中年，坐在这里心想，哦，那未必是真的。

sentences.en: Oh, not sure I had that control all along.
sentences.zh: 哦，我不确定我一直以来都有那种掌控力。

sentences.en: You no longer go to church, right?
sentences.zh: 你不再去教会了，对吧？

sentences.en: You've stopped going to church?
sentences.zh: 你已经停止去教会了？

sentences.en: Well, yes, for now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，暂时是这样。

sentences.en: I'm a complicated person, because I'm still, like, a big fan of Jesus.
sentences.zh: 我是一个复杂的人，因为我仍然是耶稣的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: I just don't like so many of his folks.
sentences.zh: 我只是不喜欢他的很多信徒。

sentences.en: But, you know, I lost my marriage in July of 2020.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我在2020年7月失去了我的婚姻。

sentences.en: So, we're at the beginning of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 那时我们正处于疫情初期。

sentences.en: So, that meant there was no church to go to for a while.
sentences.zh: 这意味着有一段时间没法去教会。

sentences.en: You know, churches were virtual.
sentences.zh: 你知道，教会都转为线上或关闭了。

sentences.en: They were shuttered.
sentences.zh: 它们都关门了。

sentences.en: And so, I didn't have to make that hard choice back then, because I had nowhere to go.
sentences.zh: 所以当时我不需要做出那个艰难的选择，因为我无处可去。

sentences.en: And by the time it was time to come back, when church started meeting again, and I went back to my own church that I was a founder of,
sentences.zh: 等到教会重新开始聚会，我回到我亲手创立的教会时，

sentences.en: and I felt like I could not shoulder everybody's shock and pain and pity that our story had disintegrated in the way that it had.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己无法承受大家对我们故事以那种方式破裂所表现出的震惊、痛苦和怜悯。

sentences.en: Having been their faith leaders from the get-go, I couldn't handle it all.
sentences.zh: 作为他们最初的信仰领袖，我无法处理这一切。

sentences.en: So, I stayed home, and I haven't gone back.
sentences.zh: 所以我待在家里，再也没有回去过。

sentences.en: And that's not to say that I won't ever.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我永远不会回去。

sentences.en: I don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: But for right now, the organized religion part of faith is the part that is not serving me right now.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，信仰中组织化宗教的部分，对我来说已经不再适用了。

sentences.en: Organized religion is not something that is nourishing or helpful to you right now.
sentences.zh: 组织化宗教目前对你来说既没有滋养作用，也没有帮助。

sentences.en: But it is clear that there are aspects of Christian faith that are meaningful to you.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，基督教信仰中仍有一些对你而言很有意义的方面。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The term you've used is bricks that are—I'm going to continue the metaphor—they are building blocks for—
sentences.zh: 你用过“砖块”这个词——我继续用这个比喻——它们是构建……的基石。

sentences.en: Good job.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: For how you live your life.
sentences.zh: 构建你生活方式的基石。

sentences.en: But it's interesting for me to hear you say that because I'm also thinking about it in the context of criticism that has been leveled at you from—
sentences.zh: 但听到你这么说很有趣，因为我也在想，这与针对你的批评有关——

sentences.en: You know, the person I'm thinking of is Allie Beth Stuckey, who a couple years ago, the way she put it was that you continually spout nonsense.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想到的人是艾莉·贝丝·斯塔基（Allie Beth Stuckey），几年前，她的说法是你一直在胡言乱语。

sentences.en: You know, and her argument is basically that you have, you know, like a salad bar approach to faith.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她的论点基本上是说你对信仰采取了一种“自助餐式”的态度。

sentences.en: You sort of pick and choose what you like and discard what you don't like.
sentences.zh: 你挑选自己喜欢的，丢弃自己不喜欢的。

sentences.en: And you sort of let your positions be defined by feelings, I would say, rather than scripture.
sentences.zh: 我想说，你让自己的立场更多地由感觉而非圣经来定义。

sentences.en: Is there something that that line of criticism is missing about you and about Christianity?
sentences.zh: 这种批评是否忽略了关于你和基督教的某些方面？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I know that criticism like the back of my hand.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我对那种批评再熟悉不过了。

sentences.en: I've been at the center of that narrative for so long.
sentences.zh: 我长期处于那种叙事的中心。

sentences.en: It'll be written on my tombstone.
sentences.zh: 这大概会写在我的墓碑上。

sentences.en: I don't listen to that, and I don't care about that, and that doesn't bother me, and I pay that no heed at all.
sentences.zh: 我不听那些，也不在乎那些，那不会困扰我，我根本不予理会。

sentences.en: And why do you think it's wrong?
sentences.zh: 那你为什么认为它是错的？

sentences.en: I think it's wrong because my faith is still what anchors me, what leads me, what compels me, what sustains me.
sentences.zh: 我认为它是错的，因为我的信仰依然是我锚定自我、指引我、驱动我、支撑我的力量。

sentences.en: It is still the driver of my life, and it's really interesting to discover that because I'd always deeply succeeded in what I considered the two institutions that kept me credible,
sentences.zh: 它依然是我生活的驱动力，发现这一点非常有趣，因为我一直深信我所认为的两个让我保持可信度的机构，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: That put me out of the line of fire of that sort of criticism, and that was church and marriage.
sentences.zh: 那两个让我免受此类批评的机构，就是教会和婚姻。

sentences.en: And so now, having lost one for sure and sort of disconnected myself from the other one, I've discovered a faith that exists beautifully outside of all of that.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，一个彻底失去了，另一个我也与之断开了联系，我发现了一种在这一切之外依然美丽存在的信仰。

sentences.en: I want to go back to the material in the book now.
sentences.zh: 我想回到书中的内容。

sentences.en: You know, I promise I don't mean this insensitively or skeptically,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我保证我不是想表现得麻木不仁或怀疑论，

sentences.en: but the story you tell in your book about divorce does fit very cleanly within the common tropes of divorce memoirs, the sort of initial conflict, grief, and then at the end,
sentences.zh: 但你在书中讲述的关于离婚的故事，确实非常符合离婚回忆录的常见套路，那种最初的冲突、悲伤，最后，

sentences.en: coming out into self-actualization, you know.
sentences.zh: 走向自我实现，你知道的。

sentences.en: Now, I suspect that things aren't always so clean.
sentences.zh: 现在，我怀疑事情并不总是那么简单。

sentences.en: Are there aspects of your divorce that you just felt didn't fit in with the larger story you were trying to tell in the book?
sentences.zh: 你离婚的过程中，是否有某些方面让你觉得不适合放入你在书中试图讲述的那个宏大故事里？

sentences.en: Well, I hope what readers will see pretty immediately is that I included every scrap of sorrow in this story.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我希望读者能很快看到，我把故事中每一丝悲伤都写进去了。

sentences.en: I shied away from none of it.
sentences.zh: 我没有回避任何一点。

sentences.en: And I hope that they'll also see that there is a, I don't know, I hope a high degree of self-awareness where I really examine my own complicity.
sentences.zh: 我也希望他们能看到，这里有一种——我不知道——我希望是一种高度的自我意识，我真正审视了自己的共谋。

sentences.en: I examine my own patterns.
sentences.zh: 我审视了自己的行为模式。

sentences.en: I talk about my failures.
sentences.zh: 我谈到了我的失败。

sentences.en: I talk about what a fumbling idiot I was when I had to all of a sudden build an adult life by myself.
sentences.zh: 我谈到了当我不得不突然独自建立成年生活时，我是个多么笨拙的白痴。

sentences.en: So it's not a shiny story.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是一个光鲜亮丽的故事。

sentences.en: But maybe it fits into the arc, because maybe that's how the arc works more than it doesn't, which is that women are truly, genuinely capable of recovery and rebuilding.
sentences.zh: 但也许它符合这个弧线，因为也许这才是弧线运作的常态，那就是女性确实、真正地有能力恢复和重建。

sentences.en: So I'd like to say that my story is not at all special.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想说，我的故事一点也不特别。

sentences.en: And I think that's what makes it important.
sentences.zh: 而我认为这正是它重要的原因。

sentences.en: And you also describe yourself in the book as being in a codependent relationship.
sentences.zh: 你在书中还描述自己处于一段共生关系中。

sentences.en: How did your codependency show up in your marriage?
sentences.zh: 你的共生关系在婚姻中是如何表现的？

sentences.en: First of all, I didn't even know what that word meant until I got divorced.
sentences.zh: 首先，在离婚之前，我甚至不知道这个词是什么意思。

sentences.en: I thought that meant needy or like fragile or something.
sentences.zh: 我以为那意味着需要人照顾，或者脆弱之类的。

sentences.en: I'm not really sure.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定。

sentences.en: But when I learned that codependency is essentially, this is a terrible reduction,
sentences.zh: 但当我了解到共生本质上是——这是一种糟糕的简化——

sentences.en: feeling and trying to become responsible for other people's choices, feelings, and lives.
sentences.zh: 感受并试图对别人的选择、感受和生活负责。

sentences.en: And then allowing however they're living their life to affect you.
sentences.zh: 然后允许他们生活的方式影响你。

sentences.en: Well, that was fairly indicting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那相当令人震惊。

sentences.en: I came to understand that I had spent my entire marriage as a codependent, which was me trying to manage my husband's behavior.
sentences.zh: 我开始明白，我整个婚姻生活都是一个共生者，也就是我一直在试图管理我丈夫的行为。

sentences.en: How he was, how he acted, how he talked.
sentences.zh: 他的状态，他的举止，他的谈吐。

sentences.en: If he hurt people's feelings, I would come behind and try to prop that up and shine that up and razzle-dazzle that a little bit.
sentences.zh: 如果他伤害了别人的感情，我会跟在后面试图修补、美化，稍微掩饰一下。

sentences.en: I did that with the kids.
sentences.zh: 我对孩子们也这样做。

sentences.en: I can't tell you how many times I'd go upstairs and be like, you know dad did not mean that.
sentences.zh: 我数不清有多少次我会上楼说，你知道爸爸不是那个意思。

sentences.en: Try to manage their feelings about it.
sentences.zh: 试图管理他们对此的感受。

sentences.en: And then it turns out I did that with a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 结果发现我对很多人都这样做过。

sentences.en: And so purging myself of codependency has been one of the biggest and heaviest lifts of the last five years.
sentences.zh: 所以，摆脱共生关系是我过去五年中最艰巨、最沉重的任务之一。

sentences.en: And anyway, I'm doing terrible at it.
sentences.zh: 总之，我在这方面做得一塌糊涂。

sentences.en: Have there been moments that made you realize in the last five years since you got divorced, that made you feel like, yes, I am on my way to being a functional independent adult?
sentences.zh: 在离婚后的这五年里，有没有什么时刻让你觉得：“是的，我正在成为一个独立的成年人”？

sentences.en: That's the good news.
sentences.zh: 这是好消息。

sentences.en: So some of it was forced.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一些是迫不得已的。

sentences.en: In which, as mentioned, I was a teenage child bride and had never spent one minute of adulthood in independence.
sentences.zh: 正如提到的，我是一个十几岁的童养媳，从未有过一分钟独立成年的经历。

sentences.en: Not one.
sentences.zh: 一分钟都没有。

sentences.en: I think you say in the book you'd never been to a movie by yourself.
sentences.zh: 我想你在书中说你从未独自去看过电影。

sentences.en: I'd never been to a movie by myself.
sentences.zh: 我从未独自去看过电影。

sentences.en: And I had handed over all financial labor to my ex-husband.
sentences.zh: 而且我把所有的财务工作都交给了我的前夫。

sentences.en: So I didn't know what our bank accounts were.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道我们的银行账户情况。

sentences.en: I did not know how much money I made.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我赚了多少钱。

sentences.en: I had never filed taxes.
sentences.zh: 我从未报过税。

sentences.en: So some of it was just by necessity.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一些纯粹是出于必要。

sentences.en: I had to build my own independent life because there was no one else to do it for me.
sentences.zh: 我必须建立自己独立的生活，因为没有别人能为我做这件事。

sentences.en: And then I discovered I'm good at this.
sentences.zh: 然后我发现我很擅长这个。

sentences.en: And I will tell you that this has been the best thing that has ever happened to me.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，这是我经历过的最好的事情。

sentences.en: I mean it.
sentences.zh: 我是认真的。

sentences.en: And I'm not trying to just put the shine back on the penny.
sentences.zh: 我不是在试图粉饰太平。

sentences.en: It's really true.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。

sentences.en: It's like I woke up halfway through my life.
sentences.zh: 就像我在人生过半时醒来了一样。

sentences.en: After the break, I talk to Jen again.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我将再次与詹交谈。

sentences.en: And we get into the parts of her divorce she's not at peace with yet.
sentences.zh: 我们将深入探讨她离婚中那些尚未释怀的部分。

sentences.en: I value marriage.
sentences.zh: 我重视婚姻。

sentences.en: I value longevity.
sentences.zh: 我重视长久。

sentences.en: My in-laws are at 53 years.
sentences.zh: 我的姻亲已经结婚53年了。

sentences.en: My parents are at 53 years.
sentences.zh: 我的父母也结婚53年了。

sentences.en: I saw that.
sentences.zh: 我看到了这一点。

sentences.en: I wanted that future.
sentences.zh: 我想要那样的未来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露（Winnalou）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基（Sam Azersky），我每天负责创建《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Hi, Jen.
sentences.zh: 嗨，詹。

sentences.en: Hey, David.
sentences.zh: 嘿，大卫。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Thank you very much for taking the time to talk with me again.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间再次与我交谈。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Delighted to.
sentences.zh: 乐意之至。

sentences.en: So, you know, I feel like I need to start on a skeptical note.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我觉得我得先从怀疑的角度切入。

sentences.en: It's something I'm thinking about.
sentences.zh: 这是我一直在思考的问题。

sentences.en: You know, you really talk a lot and have talked a lot for years about the importance of, you
sentences.zh: 你知道，你确实谈了很多，多年来也一直谈论关于诚实和真实的重要性，

sentences.en: know, honesty and authenticity, which I really think if you were to poll content creators and influencers, like the number one thing they would say that they're offering is honesty
sentences.zh: 如果你去调查那些内容创作者和网红，我想他们会说他们提供的头号价值就是诚实

sentences.en: and authenticity.
sentences.zh: 和真实。

sentences.en: Pretty buzzy, right?
sentences.zh: 听起来很时髦，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And like I told you, I've been reading your books, and I was sort of struck by how in the book that you published in 2020, which is called Fierce, Free, and Full of Fire,
sentences.zh: 就像我告诉你的，我一直在读你的书，我被你在2020年出版的那本《Fierce, Free, and Full of Fire》所触动，

sentences.en: you know, it's really a lot about honoring truthfulness and like sort of being the most truthful version of yourself.
sentences.zh: 你知道，书里很大篇幅都在讲如何尊重真实，以及如何成为最真实的自己。

sentences.en: And you even have like a little bit in there about the importance of like realness with you and your husband.
sentences.zh: 你甚至还在里面提到了你和你丈夫之间保持真实的重要性。

sentences.en: And of course, this was being written at precisely the same time that your marriage was falling apart.
sentences.zh: 当然，这本书写成的时候，恰好也是你婚姻破裂的时候。

sentences.en: So were you just not comfortable sharing that side of yourself?
sentences.zh: 所以，你是当时不太愿意分享那一面吗？

sentences.en: Or did you feel like it was too risky from like a business perspective to talk about what your real troubles were?
sentences.zh: 还是你觉得从商业角度来看，谈论你真实的困境风险太大？

sentences.en: Like, help me through my skepticism.
sentences.zh: 帮我解开我的怀疑吧。

sentences.en: Obviously, you know how publishing works.
sentences.zh: 显然，你很了解出版业的运作方式。

sentences.en: So I wrote that book in 2018.
sentences.zh: 我是在2018年写的那本书。

sentences.en: That's how long it takes.
sentences.zh: 出版周期就是那么长。

sentences.en: And so in 2018, we were not at the apex of our crisis.
sentences.zh: 所以在2018年，我们还没有处于危机的顶峰。

sentences.en: We were on the very, very slight incline to our worst final year for sure, which would have been leading up to July 2020.
sentences.zh: 我们当时肯定正处于通往最糟糕的一年——也就是2020年7月之前——那段非常、非常缓慢的下坡路上。

sentences.en: And if you, a keen eye would have noticed in Fierce that where I did talk about my marriage at length, one of the long sections was about our communication struggles.
sentences.zh: 如果你目光敏锐，就会注意到在《Fierce》中，我确实详细谈到了我的婚姻，其中很长一部分内容就是关于我们沟通上的挣扎。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And being in counseling, right?
sentences.zh: 还有接受心理咨询，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In counseling, how we were circling the drain around the same repeated patterns neither one of us could ever seem to break.
sentences.zh: 在咨询中，我们如何陷入同样的循环，无论哪一方似乎都无法打破那些重复的模式。

sentences.en: And that we were each other's trigger.
sentences.zh: 而且我们互为对方的导火索。

sentences.en: And so I think if you read with the advantage of hindsight, you can see on the page that we were slogging a little bit at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果你带着事后诸葛亮的视角去读，就能看出当时我们在书页间流露出的那种艰难。

sentences.en: But, you know, I have always said, David, and I think this is fair, that there is a difference
sentences.zh: 但是，大卫，我一直说，而且我认为这很公平，那就是存在一种区别：

sentences.en: between secrecy, which is generally marked by shame, and privacy, which is marked by discretion.
sentences.zh: 秘密通常伴随着羞耻，而隐私则伴随着审慎。

sentences.en: And even the most public person deserves some privacy inside her marriage.
sentences.zh: 即使是最公开的人物，在婚姻内部也理应拥有一些隐私。

sentences.en: And so I understand your skepticism.
sentences.zh: 所以我理解你的怀疑。

sentences.en: And I will say I certainly did not know in 2018 what I knew two years later.
sentences.zh: 我得说，2018年的我确实不知道两年后会发生什么。

sentences.en: Who are the folks that you see online when you see them posting things?
sentences.zh: 当你看到网上那些人发布内容时，有哪些人会让你觉得：啊，你满嘴胡言？

sentences.en: I'm talking about influencers or content creators that make you go, ah, you're full of baloney.
sentences.zh: 我是指那些让你觉得“你在胡说八道”的网红或内容创作者。

sentences.en: He wants me to name names.
sentences.zh: 他想让我点名。

sentences.en: I certainly feel like I have developed a bit of a radar for it, if that's what you're asking.
sentences.zh: 如果这是你想问的，我确实觉得我已经培养出了一种雷达。

sentences.en: So I recognize what, to me, I can smell in the air as fear.
sentences.zh: 所以我能识别出那些对我而言闻起来像恐惧的东西。

sentences.en: I think that's the driver.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是驱动力。

sentences.en: It's a fear of getting found out, a fear of losing what you have, or losing people's good opinion of you or your marriage, or whatever the thing is.
sentences.zh: 那是一种害怕被拆穿的恐惧，害怕失去你所拥有的东西，或者失去人们对你或你婚姻的好感，无论那是什么。

sentences.en: So I feel like I can tell when I see it.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉我能看出来。

sentences.en: Something in the eyes that's a little dim.
sentences.zh: 眼神里有些东西显得有点黯淡。

sentences.en: I'm like, I remember that feeling.
sentences.zh: 我会想，我记得那种感觉。

sentences.en: You used this metaphor a couple times of the bricks in your marriage.
sentences.zh: 你曾多次用“婚姻中的砖块”来做比喻。

sentences.en: Some of them ended up being faulty, you know, so that the foundation started to crumble.
sentences.zh: 其中一些砖块最终出了问题，导致地基开始崩塌。

sentences.en: And, you know, you said it wasn't all your ex-husband.
sentences.zh: 而且，你说过这并不全是你前夫的错。

sentences.en: Certainly.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So what were some of the faulty bricks that you were responsible for?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为自己该负责的那些“问题砖块”是什么？

sentences.en: I was responsible for plenty of it.
sentences.zh: 我对此负有很大责任。

sentences.en: I co-signed the gender role that I was handed.
sentences.zh: 我认可了被强加给我的性别角色。

sentences.en: I was signed at the bottom and said, I agree.
sentences.zh: 我在下面签了字，说：我同意。

sentences.en: I agree to these limits.
sentences.zh: 我同意这些限制。

sentences.en: I agree to this subservience.
sentences.zh: 我同意这种顺从。

sentences.en: I will uphold these standards.
sentences.zh: 我会维护这些标准。

sentences.en: And so I not only towed that line for a long time, I repeated it.
sentences.zh: 所以我不仅长期遵守那条线，我还重复了它。

sentences.en: And I taught it.
sentences.zh: 并且我教导了它。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You were sort of like a willing accomplice.
sentences.zh: 你就像是一个心甘情愿的同谋。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: You know, sort of in the context of gender roles, I think that sort of an under-discussed
sentences.zh: 你知道，在性别角色的背景下，我认为关于离婚有一个被讨论不足的话题，

sentences.en: subject related to divorce is the way that people in a relationship or in a marriage, they do take on a sexual identity.
sentences.zh: 那就是处于一段关系或婚姻中的人，他们确实会承担起一种性身份。

sentences.en: And then when that relationship ends, you know, it can be necessary, but also hard for people to sort of forge a new sexual identity for themselves.
sentences.zh: 然后当那段关系结束时，人们重新塑造自己的性身份既是必要的，也是困难的。

sentences.en: And I don't want to come off as like remotely skeevy or like I'm crying into your life.
sentences.zh: 我不想显得猥琐，或者好像在窥探你的生活。

sentences.en: David's being pervy, you guys.
sentences.zh: 大卫在耍流氓呢，大家。

sentences.en: Like have your own ideas about sex and sexuality changed both since marriage ended and also since leaving the church?
sentences.zh: 那么，自从婚姻结束以及离开教会后，你对性和性取向的看法是否发生了变化？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The short answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是：是的。

sentences.en: And truly, how could it not?
sentences.zh: 说真的，怎么可能不发生变化呢？

sentences.en: I mean, until 2020, I hadn't had sex with a different person since 1992.
sentences.zh: 我是说，直到2020年，我自1992年以来就没和别人发生过性关系。

sentences.en: It's been a minute.
sentences.zh: 那可是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And I was a young kid with some weird, malformed ideas about sexual health and possibility and connection and my own body, my own preferences.
sentences.zh: 那时我还是个孩子，对性健康、可能性、亲密关系以及我自己的身体和偏好，有着一些奇怪且畸形的观念。

sentences.en: Not one person ever talked to us about our own preferences.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人跟我们谈论过我们自己的偏好。

sentences.en: That was not a thing.
sentences.zh: 那根本不是个事儿。

sentences.en: And so I'm grown now.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在长大了。

sentences.en: And I'm in much better control of my own self-awareness in every possible way, but including a sexual ethic.
sentences.zh: 在自我意识的各个方面，包括性伦理，我都有了更好的掌控力。

sentences.en: And of course, you know, there's sort of a trope that women around my age get divorced and just absolutely go bananas, you know, just bananas.
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道，有一种老套的说法是，像我这个年纪的女性离婚后就会彻底疯掉，你知道，就是彻底疯掉。

sentences.en: That wasn't my story.
sentences.zh: 那不是我的故事。

sentences.en: I'm not judgmental of it.
sentences.zh: 我并不评判那种行为。

sentences.en: I'm truly not.
sentences.zh: 真的没有。

sentences.en: But that was never really going to be my way.
sentences.zh: 但这从来都不是我的方式。

sentences.en: It's juSt...
sentences.zh: 这只是……

sentences.en: Like middle-aged spring break or something.
sentences.zh: 就像中年人的春假之类的。

sentences.en: Completely.
sentences.zh: 完全是。

sentences.en: And in fact, I spent exactly 12 hours on a dating app before bursting into tears, pulling my sweatshirt over my face and deleting the app.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我在约会软件上待了整整12个小时，然后就泪流满面，把卫衣拉过头顶，删掉了那个软件。

sentences.en: So that's how well that went for me.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我尝试的结果。

sentences.en: But it is interesting to have grown up, to have become mature, to have developed the capacity for
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，在成长、成熟、培养出批判性思维能力之后，

sentences.en: critical thinking, to examine the systems, the rules, the limitations that I was handed as an 18-year-old and go, all right, where are we at now?
sentences.zh: 去审视那些我在18岁时被灌输的系统、规则和限制，然后想：好吧，我们现在处于什么位置？

sentences.en: And so I think it's an interesting time to have a bit of a sexual renaissance.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为现在是一个经历某种“性复兴”的有趣时刻。

sentences.en: If I am allowed to say that, this is a better version of me in every way.
sentences.zh: 如果我能这么说的话，这是我在各方面都更好的一个版本。

sentences.en: You know, I want to return to the subject of the story that often gets told about divorce.
sentences.zh: 我想回到关于离婚故事的话题上。

sentences.en: We talked about the idea of common divorce narratives or tropes, you know, like they start in a rough place and kind of like end in an unambiguously better place.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了常见的离婚叙事或套路，你知道，比如他们从糟糕的境地开始，最后以一种毫无疑问更好的结局收场。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I just want to try and complicate that a little bit one more time.
sentences.zh: 我只是想再试着让它复杂一点点。

sentences.en: And I'll use a personal example.
sentences.zh: 我用一个个人例子来说明。

sentences.en: My parents divorced when I was very young and it was 100% the right decision.
sentences.zh: 我父母在我很小的时候就离婚了，这百分之百是正确的决定。

sentences.en: But I think the experience affected my parents and my brother and I in ways that I think, you know, sort of still have ripples all these years later.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这段经历以某种方式影响了我的父母、我和我哥哥，你知道，这些影响在多年后依然有涟漪。

sentences.en: And, you know, the feelings got shut away or feelings got stunted.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那些感受被压抑了，或者说情感发育受阻了。

sentences.en: And I think it's fair to say that, you know, some things got broken and they were put together, but it was not like they were put together like brand new again.
sentences.zh: 我认为公平地说，有些东西破碎了，虽然被拼凑起来，但并不像全新的那样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I just think it's sometimes when things break, they don't get, you know, you can't put Humpty Dumpty back together again.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得有时候当东西破碎了，你无法让“矮胖子”复原。

sentences.en: Um, I'm sure my parents would be super happy about me comparing their divorce to Humpty Dumpty.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我敢肯定我父母如果听到我把他们的离婚比作“矮胖子”会非常高兴。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But, um, but do you think there are things with your divorce that you feel like you haven't been able to integrate or that just don't fit into the everything is better now?
sentences.zh: 但是，你认为在你的离婚中，有没有什么事情是你觉得无法整合的，或者说根本无法塞进“现在一切都好”这个故事里的？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: Story?
sentences.zh: 故事？

sentences.en: So what are those things?
sentences.zh: 那是什么呢？

sentences.en: Uh, and I don't think I ever said everything is better now.
sentences.zh: 呃，我不认为我曾经说过“现在一切都好”。

sentences.en: I didn't write that story because I've not lived that story.
sentences.zh: 我没有写过那个故事，因为我没有过那种生活。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's tempting to assign that meaning, except I didn't say that.
sentences.zh: 赋予那种意义很诱人，但我没说过。

sentences.en: And that's not real life.
sentences.zh: 那不是真实的生活。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Um, my oldest son, Gavin, and his sweet young wife are about to have their first baby in six weeks, his first grandbaby.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的大儿子加文和他甜美的年轻妻子六周后就要生第一个孩子了，这是我的第一个孙辈。

sentences.en: Um, what we always dreamed about was those kids bringing home that baby to our house and we would rock them on the porch for all their days.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们一直梦想的是孩子们把那个宝宝带回我们的家，我们可以在门廊上摇着他们度过余生。

sentences.en: Nobody dreams about bringing their new baby to two different houses, to two different families.
sentences.zh: 没有人梦想着把刚出生的宝宝带到两个不同的房子、两个不同的家庭里去。

sentences.en: It is not perfect.
sentences.zh: 这并不完美。

sentences.en: You cannot glue Humpty completely back together.
sentences.zh: 你无法把“矮胖子”完全粘回去。

sentences.en: Again, there's cracks and there's some missing pieces.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，裂缝还在，还有一些缺失的碎片。

sentences.en: And some of that will just always be true.
sentences.zh: 其中一些将永远是事实。

sentences.en: When it comes to my kids' story, that is certainly true.
sentences.zh: 当谈到我孩子的故事时，这当然是真的。

sentences.en: There's their life split in half.
sentences.zh: 他们的生活被一分为二了。

sentences.en: There's a before and an after for them.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，有一个“之前”和一个“之后”。

sentences.en: And to some degree, the after will always be a little sad.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，“之后”总是会带有一点悲伤。

sentences.en: And it will be for me too.
sentences.zh: 对我来说也是如此。

sentences.en: I had a different vision for my life.
sentences.zh: 我对我的生活有不同的愿景。

sentences.en: And I value marriage.
sentences.zh: 我珍视婚姻。

sentences.en: I value longevity.
sentences.zh: 我珍视长久。

sentences.en: My in-laws are at 53 years.
sentences.zh: 我的公婆结婚53年了。

sentences.en: My parents are at 53 years.
sentences.zh: 我的父母结婚53年了。

sentences.en: I saw that.
sentences.zh: 我见过那种生活。

sentences.en: I wanted that future.
sentences.zh: 我想要那种未来。

sentences.en: To say nothing of the lingering effects of just pain, without zhuzhing it up, just the pain of betrayal and of loss and divorce is sad.
sentences.zh: 更不用说那些挥之不去的痛苦影响了，不加修饰地说，背叛、失去和离婚的痛苦本身就是悲伤的。

sentences.en: And so I don't think I, I know that I have never said everything is so perfect now.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我没有，我知道我从未说过“现在一切都太完美了”。

sentences.en: But I do stand by this, having access to literally hundreds of thousands of women.
sentences.zh: 但我坚持这一点，因为我能接触到成千上万的女性。

sentences.en: I do see that there is a real common experience where women have lost a marriage around here, around this middle space, in often devastating ways, soul-crushing ways.
sentences.zh: 我确实看到了一种非常普遍的经历，女性在这个中年阶段失去了婚姻，往往是以毁灭性的、令人心碎的方式。

sentences.en: And they don't just recover, they rebuild, and they ultimately flourish.
sentences.zh: 她们不仅仅是恢复，她们在重建，并最终蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: And I am just convinced that women are not permanently defined by the men who leave them.
sentences.zh: 我深信女性不会被离开她们的男人永久定义。

sentences.en: You see it once, maybe.
sentences.zh: 你可能只见过一次。

sentences.en: You see it twice, hmm.
sentences.zh: 你见过两次，嗯。

sentences.en: You see it thousands of times, you go, maybe this is not a story that always ends in sorrow.
sentences.zh: 当你见过成千上万次，你就会想，也许这不是一个总是以悲伤告终的故事。

sentences.zh: 即使在很小的时候，我就能看出她对我和哥哥的愤怒，在某种程度上与她自己的经历有关。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是他们会不会喝到断片才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这非常具体。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物不耐受吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 或者在你喜欢的任何平台收听。
